name: quant-tutor-bench-data
description: A dataset of quantitative tutoring problems intended to evaluate models on quantitative reasoning and problem solving, often requiring stepwise solutions and final numeric answers. It is aimed at assessing both final-answer accuracy and the ability to produce explanatory steps.
evaluation_method: accuracy / exact_match on final answers (optionally evaluated with partial-credit or step-checking for solution steps)
reputation: A focused educational benchmark hosted on Hugging Face for tutoring/quantitative reasoning tasks; limited but growing use in academic and edtech evaluations.
